headline: Bitcoin climbed to about $63,000 on Monday as Wall Street rallied on Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia's CEO, but money is still leaving bitcoin funds and traders expect a Fed rate hike in December.

market.asOf: Bitcoin and ether are CoinDesk's figures (bitcoin at 10:42am ET, ether at 8:53am ET, Mon 23 Nov); live price pages could not be read reliably this run, so solana is left blank. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 11 out of 100 ("Extreme Fear") on the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index, read about 15:57 UTC Mon 23 Nov; CoinMarketCap's own index was 9 ("extreme fear"), per CoinDesk at 6:51am ET.

stories.title: Bitcoin climbs to about $63,000 as Wall Street rallies on Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
stories.summary: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, effective immediately, and US stocks jumped. Bitcoin and crypto stocks rose with them. The bounce came from a tech relief rally rather than crypto news, and bitcoin is still not far from its weekend low, the weakest since September 2024.
points: Nvidia shares were up 27% after the news, per CoinDesk at 9:13am ET; the board said it found no national security risk after consulting senior US officials.
By 10:42am ET the Nasdaq was up 7.5% and the S&P 500 5.5%, per CoinDesk's live blog.
Bitcoin touched $63,800 and was about $63,000 at 10:42am ET, up 3.7% in 24 hours, per CoinDesk; its weekend low was $55,130, per CoinDesk.
Crypto stocks jumped at 10:42am ET: Strategy +14%, Galaxy +19%, Circle +12%, Coinbase +8.3%, per CoinDesk.
Sentiment is still at "Extreme Fear": 11 on the alternative.me index.

sources.label: CoinDesk: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO

stories.title: Money keeps leaving bitcoin funds, and traders see a December Fed hike as near-certain
stories.summary: Under Monday's rally the backdrop is still tough. US spot bitcoin funds lost money again last week, traders price a Fed rate hike in December as almost certain, and US business activity slowed in November. October PCE inflation comes out Wednesday in a short Thanksgiving week.
points: US spot bitcoin funds lost $1.79 billion last week, with BlackRock's IBIT losing $1.368 billion; their total assets were $71.35 billion, per Bloomingbit citing SoSoValue.
CoinDesk's live blog put the chance of a December hike at "essentially" 100% at 10:23am ET; KuCoin, citing CME FedWatch, had a quarter-point hike at 93.2%.
The 10-year Treasury yield was 4.95% at 10:23am ET, and earlier on Monday the dollar index rose above 104, its highest since March 2025, per CoinDesk's live blog.
November flash PMIs: services 54.7 (expected 55.6, October 56.1) and manufacturing 54.5 (as expected, October 54.9), per Newsquawk.
US stock markets and the spot crypto funds are closed Thursday 26 Nov for Thanksgiving; crypto itself keeps trading, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Kalshi faces a New York court hearing today that it says could shut it down
stories.summary: New York's Attorney General is asking a state court for a restraining order against the prediction market Kalshi. Kalshi says the order's wording would shut down its exchange for every customer; New York says it is not seeking a nationwide shutdown.
points: Justice Melissa Crane hears the request at 11:30am ET Mon 23 Nov (23:30 Bangkok) in New York County Supreme Court, per Inside Bitcoins.
The order would bar unlicensed gambling contracts "within or from New York or to persons in New York", covering sports, elections and other events, per Inside Bitcoins.
On Fri 20 Nov a federal judge rejected the CFTC's emergency bid to block New York's case, per The Block.

briefs.title: OKX and ICE launch a tokenized stock venue
briefs.summary: OKXICE, a joint venture of OKX and Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), went live with 113 assets for round-the-clock trading; 67 companies, including Apple, Microsoft and Nvidia, objected to having their shares listed, per The Block.

briefs.title: Binance hackers move $247 million through bitcoin mixing transactions
briefs.summary: The hackers pushed $247 million through coinjoins, which pool coins to hide where they came from; Elliptic says $2.85 billion of the October hack is frozen or seized, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Chainflip hack bounty deadline is today
briefs.summary: Chainflip's 10% bounty offer ends at 18:38 UTC Mon 23 Nov (01:38 Tue Bangkok); losses total about $12 million, including 122.86 BTC, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy buys more bitcoin
briefs.summary: Strategy bought 457 BTC for $29.6 million and now holds 851,305 BTC, per CoinDesk's live blog.

briefs.title: Bitmine nears 5% of all ether
briefs.summary: Bitmine added 7,819 ETH and now holds 6,085,564 ETH, 4.98% of supply, per CoinDesk's live blog.

briefs.title: Monad's large MON unlock is Tuesday
briefs.summary: CoinDesk puts Tuesday's MON unlock at about $217 million, about 140% of circulating supply. See the unlock table on this page for this desk's size and confidence.

calendar.note: On the economic outlook and monetary policy, per the New York Fed. Zoom and HPE report earnings after the close, per heygotrade.

Expected at 92.1 per heygotrade, 92.5 per CoinDesk; 91.7 in October. Dell, Workday, Autodesk and HP report after the close, per heygotrade.

calendar.event: US PCE inflation (Oct), Q3 GDP (second estimate), durable goods and jobless claims
calendar.note: Core PCE is expected at 3.4% a year per ZeroHedge, 3.3% per RBC via Bloomingbit (September 3.1%); headline at 3.8% (September 3.6%), per ZeroHedge. Q3 GDP is expected at 3.5% per ZeroHedge or 3.4% per CoinDesk. Jobless claims are expected at 200K per ZeroHedge (prior 203K).
NYSE is closed Thursday and closes early at 1:00pm ET on Friday 27 Nov (01:00 Sat Bangkok), per NYSE's holiday calendar. Crypto trades through the holiday.

calendar.event: Monthly bitcoin options expiry on Deribit
calendar.note: About $6.8 billion of bitcoin options (112,323 BTC) expire with the "max pain" level at $73,000, per Cryptoticker using Deribit data from 21 Nov; KCEX (17 Nov) put it at $6.5 billion with max pain at $75,000.
Per the BLS release schedule; it comes out before the Fed's 8-9 Dec meeting.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Per the Federal Reserve's calendar. Odds of a quarter-point hike: 93.2% per KuCoin citing CME FedWatch; CoinDesk's live blog called a hike "essentially" 100% on 23 Nov.
